info.name: Nearby - Identity API
info.description: Accounts and authorization (SRS 3.1). Run the folders in order. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable code field. Contract: docs/api/identity-api.md.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Public endpoints under /api/v1/auth plus password and email under /api/v1/users/me (FR-ID-01..05, 07..09). Set the phone variable to your own number when SMS_PROVIDER=esms.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit code by SMS (FR-ID-02). With SMS_PROVIDER=log the code is in the backend log (search "[sms disabled]"); copy it into the otp collection variable. 429 OTP_RATE_LIMITED within 60 s or after 5 codes per day, 503 SMS_UNAVAILABLE when the gateway fails, 400 INVALID_PHONE.
The password policy is checked before the code; the answer lists every violated rule.

Creates an ACTIVE account with a verified phone, records TERMS/PRIVACY consent and returns a token pair (FR-ID-01). 422 OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / CONSENT_REQUIRED, 409 PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED / POLICY_VERSION_STALE, 400 WEAK_PASSWORD, 429 per client IP.
Same answer as an unknown number.

Logs in with the phone number or a verified email (FR-ID-03). 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (with reason and suspendedUntil) / ACCOUNT_BANNED (with reason), 429 LOGIN_LOCKED after 5 failures for the identifier or 20 from the client IP in 15 minutes. Logging in cancels a pending deletion.
Rotates the refresh token. Presenting an already rotated token returns 401 REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED and revokes the whole chain.
Run after 'Refresh tokens': the previous token was rotated, so this revokes the chain. Log in again afterwards.
FR-ID-08: other devices are logged out, this session stays. 400 CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID / PASSWORD_REUSED.
FR-ID-09: stores the address unverified and emails a link valid 24 h. With MAIL_ENABLED=false the link is in the backend log; copy its token into verificationToken. 409 EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE.
Sends a new link to the unverified address (5 per address per hour).
Single-use token from the email link. 422 INVALID_VERIFICATION_TOKEN.
FR-ID-07: same answer whether or not the number has an account; the SMS is sent only when it has one. Send an email address as identifier to get a reset link instead (channel EMAIL).
Exchanges the SMS code for a single-use reset token. Put the new code into otp first.
Sets the new password and logs out every session. 422 RESET_TOKEN_INVALID.
Revokes the refresh token; fcmToken (optional) stops pushes to this device (FR-ID-05). Always 204.

item.name: 2. Profile
item.description: The current user's profile and avatar (FR-ID-03). Requires {{accessToken}} from Login.

request.description: Returns the profile; avatarUrl is a presigned GET URL.
Display name 2-30 characters, changeable once every 30 days (422 NAME_CHANGE_TOO_SOON with nextAllowedAt). homeArea is rounded to 3 decimals.
Step 1. JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, otherwise 400 INVALID_IMAGE. Upload the file with 'PUT {{avatarUploadUrl}}' and the returned requiredHeaders.

item.name: Request avatar upload URL - unsupported format

request.description: GIF is not accepted.
Step 2, after uploading to the presigned URL. 400 AVATAR_NOT_UPLOADED, INVALID_AVATAR_KEY or INVALID_IMAGE (the uploaded object is deleted).
Removes the avatar.
FR-ID-13: name, avatar, phone badge and join date only; never phone, email or coordinates.
FR-ID-16: 202 PENDING_DELETION with deleteAfter (7 days). Logging in before then cancels it. 400 CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID, 403 CANNOT_DELETE_ADMIN, 409 ACCOUNT_DELETION_BLOCKED.

item.name: 3. Consents
item.description: Consent per purpose (FR-ID-15): precise location and marketing pushes.

request.description: granted is true only for an active consent to currentTermsVersion.
400 OUTDATED_TERMS_VERSION when termsVersion is not the current version.
Stops precise location collection; already collected data follows the retention rules.
Newest row for TERMS, PRIVACY, PRECISE_LOCATION and PUSH_MARKETING.
Granting again while active keeps the existing row.
Always 204.

item.name: 4. Admin - users
item.description: ADMIN role only (FR-ID-04, FR-ID-05). Start with 'Admin login'; the backend creates the first admin from ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD on startup.

request.description: Logs in as the bootstrap admin.
query matches phone, email or display name. status: ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, BANNED, PENDING_DELETION, DELETED.
404 USER_NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

Bans the account for good (ACTIVE or SUSPENDED), revokes its sessions immediately, writes the audit log and publishes UserSanctioned(BAN). 403 CANNOT_LOCK_OWN_ACCOUNT / CANNOT_LOCK_ADMIN, 409 ACCOUNT_STATUS_CONFLICT.
days is 1, 7 or 30 (400 INVALID_SUSPENSION_PERIOD). Revokes sessions, audits USER_SUSPENDED and publishes UserSanctioned(SUSPENSION). The account is ACTIVE again when the suspension ends.
Lifts a suspension or a ban; publishes SanctionLifted. 409 ACCOUNT_STATUS_CONFLICT when neither.

item.name: Admin endpoint with a USER token

request.description: A USER token gets 403 ACCESS_DENIED (the attempt is logged).

item.name: 5. Blocks
item.description: FR-ID-14. Set blockedUserId to another account's id first.

request.description: 204, idempotent. 400 CANNOT_BLOCK_SELF, 404 USER_NOT_FOUND.
Newest first, cursor paged.
204, idempotent.

item.name: 6. Trading gate
item.description: FR-ID-20, flow F15: ask before posting, chatting or making an offer.

request.description: Whether the caller may trade, and which conditions are missing. A user without an area gets NO_VALID_AREA.

exec: pm.test("Failures use the FR-ID-20 codes", () => gate.failures.forEach(f => pm.expect(["ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED", "PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED", "NO_VALID_AREA", "AREA_EXPIRED", "CONSENT_MISSING"]).to.include(f)));

request.description: Typical error: the endpoint needs an access token.
